aspects.says: Blank lines, empty or whitespace only, take no part in the count and come out empty, so the value does not depend on how an editor treats them.
basis: section:The Compiler Removes the Smallest Indentation Among the Non-Blank Lines and the Closing Line

aspects.says: A closing delimiter on its own line left of the content leaves the difference in front of every line.
basis: section:Moving the Closing Delimiter Left Indents Every Line; Moving It Right Changes Nothing

aspects.says: A closing delimiter on its own line right of the content removes no more than the content allows.
basis: section:Moving the Closing Delimiter Left Indents Every Line; Moving It Right Changes Nothing

aspects.says: Ending a line with \s keeps the spaces before it, because escapes are translated after the stripping.
basis: section:Trailing Whitespace Is Removed from Every Line
aspects.reason: \s belongs to unit 7.4.4, whose practices check it; here it is only the fix for the trailing-whitespace rule

aspects.says: A multi-line value inserted with formatted() is not re-indented: only its first line gets the whitespace in front of the placeholder.
basis: section:At Run Time, Indentation Is Your Job: indent() and stripIndent()

aspects.says: indent(n) adds n spaces to every line, blank lines included, normalises line terminators to \n and ends the result with one.
basis: section:At Run Time, Indentation Is Your Job: indent() and stripIndent()

aspects.says: Four extra leading spaces turn a Markdown message into a code block.
basis: section:Moving the Closing Delimiter Left Indents Every Line; Moving It Right Changes Nothing

aspects.says: javac removes from every line of a text block the smallest leading-whitespace count among its non-blank lines and the closing delimiter's line; indentation beyond it is kept.
basis: section:The Compiler Removes the Smallest Indentation Among the Non-Blank Lines and the Closing Line

aspects.says: stripIndent() counts the last line even if blank, so text that ends with a line break keeps its common indentation.
basis: section:At Run Time, Indentation Is Your Job: indent() and stripIndent()

aspects.says: A tab counts as one character of indentation, like a space, so a tab-indented line among space-indented ones comes out misaligned.
basis: section:A Tab and a Space Each Count as One Character

aspects.says: Whitespace at the end of every line of a text block is removed, so padding typed in the source is lost.
basis: section:Trailing Whitespace Is Removed from Every Line

aspects.says: javac -Xlint:text-blocks, off by default, warns about trailing whitespace that will be removed and about inconsistent indentation.
basis: section:Trailing Whitespace Is Removed from Every Line
section:A Tab and a Space Each Count as One Character
